board.text: The value of ∫ x^x (1 + log x) dx is equal to ____.
board.answer: (b) x^x + c (since d/dx(x^x) = x^x (1 + log x)).
(c) (1/12) sin 3x + (3/4) sin x + c (using cos³x = (cos 3x + 3 cos x)/4).

Let I = ∫ √(a² − x²) · 1 dx. Using integration by parts:
I = √(a² − x²) · x − ∫ [ (−2x / 2√(a² − x²)) · x ] dx
= x√(a² − x²) + ∫ x²/√(a² − x²) dx = x√(a² − x²) + ∫ [a² − (a² − x²)]/√(a² − x²) dx
= x√(a² − x²) + a² sin⁻¹(x/a) − I
⇒ 2I = x√(a² − x²) + a² sin⁻¹(x/a)
⇒ I = (x/2)√(a² − x²) + (a²/2) sin⁻¹(x/a) + c.
